Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Tempera Tracking
- Changed Tempera shield tracking to avoid the hook-loading failure.
- Preserved checks against false cooldown reductions from expiry, conversion, death, and shield overwrites.
- Shield-break results are checked when their short waiting period finishes instead of checking the party every frame.

Cooldown Performance
- Party information is checked once per second. Captured ability uses still update immediately.
- Fully ready teammate icons stop unnecessary timer updates until an ability is used or tracking needs refreshing. Running and uncertain timers continue updating.
- Resets, roster changes, and lost capture history refresh cached icons so they do not keep stale ready information.
- Reduced temporary party-data objects and repeated local-player lookups.
